text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, as I was walking down 
the hallway, a loud commotion echoed from 
the stair landing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am the supreme ruler of the world, the 
Uma King Golshi! Bow your heads low! Kneel 
before me!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No! El is not one of your underlings!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Thank goodness you asked! Golshi-san 
is the Uma King right now, de-su.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She got completely hooked on a popular 
RPG, and she's been like this all morning, 
desu!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Uma King... the one who stands at the 
very summit! The pinnacle!! Alright, you 
there!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The peak means the strongest! The 
strongest is the peak! Answer me this: how 
does one reach that summit?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
T-The peak means the strongest...?! The 
strongest is the peak?! El understands 
now!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It takes an unyielding heart! A fiery 
soul! A burning fighting spirit, deee-su!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, why are you getting so fired 
up? You ain't a little kid, chill out...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You guys don't get it at all! Let me teach 
ya, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We're building a castle right here!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When you think of the peak, you think of a 
castle! Build a castle and stand at the 
very top! That's what being the strongest 
is all about!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's... the strongest...! I see, that 
actually makes sense!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? But if we just need to stand 
somewhere high up, wouldn't the school 
rooftop be enough...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa! Do you not want to conquer 
the summit?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you're a condor, aim for the skies! You 
crave that blue peak... the throne of the 
strongest, don'tcha?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhh...! The throne of the strongest! I 
want it, de-su!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then build a castle! Build a castle and 
try taking that crown from Lord Golshi!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's survival of the fittest out here... 
Only the strong who overcome everything 
can change the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Khh! Mighty warriors! Transcendence! The 
ultimate showdown!! This is gonna be an 
epic clash, deee-su!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get started right away! 
...But how on earth do we build a castle?

El Condor Pasa seemed completely swept up 
in Gold Ship's wild momentum... If I were 
to offer some advice for now――
choice_data_list:
Maybe look for materials we could use for 
a castle?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A fishing boat it is then! One with giant 
cannons!! Let's slay a giant squid and 
become the Fisher Kings!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, wouldn't treasure hunting be way 
faster? Alright, Pirate King it is!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
?! What happened to the Uma King, desu 
ka?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, hop on! I'll let you ride on Lord 
Golshi's flagship!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Eh, wait... what?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The grand ocean awaits us! Set sail for 
the legendary island... anchors aweeeigh!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que?! N-No way!! El never asked to go to 
sea... Aaaaahhh?!

...Hoisting a struggling El Condor Pasa 
onto her shoulders, Gold Ship dashed off 
into the distance. Setting out for the 
far-off ocean...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Then that's gotta be it!!

Gold Ship darted over to the jungle gym, 
scrambled all the way to the very top, and 
raised her arms high in triumph.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahaha! I am the Uma King Golshi! Come 
at me, Hero El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ! Hero...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Very well! The strongest Hero El shall 
drag you down from your throne!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Big sisters, what're you playing?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: That looks fun! Let us play too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, bringing your lackeys with ya, huh?! 
Fine by me, catch me if you can! Hup!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're Soldier A! You know your line, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!!

For quite a while after that, I watched 
over the battle between the Uma King and 
the heroes led by El Condor Pasa.
